title: Canonical Financial Model (Ingested Market Data)
description: Column, unit, and currency contract for quantitative market data entering the co-consult analysis pipeline. The canonical financial model is the single shape every consumer relies on: financial-kpi.ts (python/kpi.py) reads meta + data; financial-driver-tree.ts reads the same model; the financial-modeling skill uses it as the baseline-company input for benefit models. Any ingestion provider (DART today, other disclosure systems tomorrow) MUST emit this shape before its data reaches the KPI pipeline. Closes docs/variant-benchmark-backlog.md section 4 'No quantitative dataset schema convention for ingested market data' (gap closed 2026-08-26).

corp_code.description: Provider issuer identifier (DART corp code under the KR reference implementation)

ticker.description: Exchange ticker when the company is listed

industry.description: Mapping profile used, e.g. 'general' — selects the account-mapping rules in python/mappings/

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the reporting currency, e.g. 'KRW'

unit.description: Scale unit for EVERY value in data — currency code plus magnitude, e.g. 'KRW_billions'. All line items share this single unit; percentages never appear in data (they are computed downstream in KPI outputs only)

years.description: Fiscal years present, ordered oldest-first (growth KPIs read year[i-1] and year[i-2])

mapping_version.description: Version of the account-mapping profile applied

mapped_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the normalization run

data.description: Per-year line items keyed by fiscal year string. Values are in meta.unit; null means the disclosure did not report the item (never zero-fill an unreported item). The set of year keys SHOULD exactly equal meta.years — consumers iterate meta.years, so an undeclared extra year key is dead weight (a cross-field equality JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express statically; the normalize reference producer guarantees it by construction).

unmapped_accounts.description: Audit trail: disclosure accounts the mapping profile could not classify. Review before trusting coverage stats; recurring entries indicate the mapping profile needs a new rule.

amount.description: Line-item value in meta.unit; null = not reported
